top_offers.title: Founding Engineer
top_offers.why: Zauber builds autonomous AI agents for global logistics operators already live in Europe and Asia, backed by P9, a top early-stage European fund. The role is full-stack founding-engineer ownership on Node.js/TypeScript/React with real equity, which lines up closely with Magino's build-from-zero path at Alaya and his current AI-augmented engineering focus.
